name: helix
description: Helix — a durable, policy-controlled autonomous multi-agent orchestration runtime.

scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.benchmark: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node benchmarks/runtime.mjs
scripts.golden-demo: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node examples/golden-demo.mjs
scripts.sandbox-demo: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/examples/helix-sandbox-demo.js
scripts.memory-benchmark: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/benchmarks/memory-learning.js
scripts.mcp:serve: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/apps/mcp/src/index.js
scripts.mcp:serve:http: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/apps/mcp/src/index.js --http
scripts.mcp:demo: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/examples/helix-mcp-demo.js
scripts.mcp:benchmark: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/benchmarks/mcp.js
scripts.intelligence:demo: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/examples/helix-intelligence-demo.js
scripts.intelligence:benchmark: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/benchmarks/intelligence.js
scripts.swarm:demo: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/examples/helix-swarm-demo.js
scripts.swarm:benchmark: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/benchmarks/swarm.js
scripts.federation:demo: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/examples/helix-federation-demo.js
scripts.federation:benchmark: pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/benchmarks/federation.js
